g.text: Supabase Auth owns the credential: there is no
passwordHash here. 2.1.7 and 10.3.1 are still met —
the hash lives in the auth schema of the same
database — but this row is a profile, joined to the
failedAttempts and lockedUntil stay ours, because
2.1.10 is specified more precisely than any provider
PestProfile is configuration, not user data
10.6.2). It is an entity because it is read at scoring
time like any other, but it is loaded from
a use case. 4.2.7 refuses a catalogue in which no pest
normalised against the most severe pest, and the tier
thresholds in 4.1.8 mean what they meant in v0.8 only
A Report has a reporter, a status and
accountability; an observation has none of the three. It
is a naturalist's sighting retrieved under 1.5, and
4.1.26 forbids labelling it as pest pressure anywhere it
is shown. Records whose supplier obscured the
randomises the point within roughly a 22 km box, so it
cannot be attributed to a locality at all.
A referral writes no TreatmentRecord and no WorkOrder
(8.6.10, 8.6.11). The locality was not treated. Recording
treatment recency the system did not earn would corrupt
the 4.1.17 feedback loop, which is the one thing that
makes a score fall after work is done.
status is private with no public setter.
applyStatus() is package-visible in effect: it is
validates the transition first. This is 8.3.2
enforced by encapsulation rather than by convention.
The other twelve entity classes — Session,
typed in src/entity. They are omitted here only to
+countByLocality(pest : PestType, localityId : Uuid, days : number) : Promise<number>
per driver its evidence tier allows: seven for tier A, six
for tier B, five for tier C (4.3.4 to 4.3.6). The lower
bound is a requirement, not a convenience — 4.3.10 says a
tier C pest scores with no external source at all, and five
is what remains when there is none.
One per aggregate root. The rest of the
system never writes SQL: it asks a repository. Three
consequences the design depends on — spatial predicates
control classes are unit-testable against in-memory
fakes, which 10.6.3 requires; and the store could be
replaced without touching a control class.
